kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: In a first, Chinese woman wins the prestigious Fields Medal
wire.summary: Despite criticisms of a brain drain from China to the U.S., the awards come at a time when several high-profile Chinese scholars have returned home, some citing an increasingly hostile academic environment in America.

wire.title: Republicans urge Justice Department to investigate former prosecutor Jack Smith
wire.summary: The former special counsel led two criminal investigations of President Trump and has been a frequent target of Trump's ire on social media.

wire.title: Get into med school in the graphic memoir 'See One, Do One, Teach One'
wire.summary: Grace Farris' book brings readers behind the med school scenes — documenting anxiety over loans, bouts of impostor syndrome, friendships forged in stress, and the ever-impossible work-life balance.

wire.title: U.S. signs nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia. And, Nolan Wells' independent autopsy results
wire.summary: The U.S. has signed a nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia. And, the independent autopsy results of Nolan Wells fuel more questions surrounding his cause of death.

wire.title: This AI tool promises a 'second sight of eyes' to clinicians. Did patients benefit?
wire.summary: Medical workers in a Nairobi clinic used an AI tool to check their work. A new study evaluates the result.

wire.title: Why health officials do not have a good handle on the current Ebola outbreak
wire.summary: To get slightly ahead of the virus, health officials need to quickly identify people at risk of infection, a practice known as contact tracing. That's a challenge in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

wire.title: Trump says Saudi Arabia's nuclear deal hinges on the kingdom normalizing Israel ties
wire.summary: After a Saudi nuclear power deal raised alarm in Israel, President Trump announced online that the arrangement is subject to the kingdom normalizing relations with Israel through the Abraham Accords.

wire.title: How predominantly Black areas in 6 states have been split up by redistricting
wire.summary: These maps show that the redistricting battle President Trump initiated has so far had a particular impact on largely Black congressional districts in Republican-led states.

wire.title: A town renamed its festival 'AI Love Irondale Day.' Then came the comments
wire.summary: The online outcry over the renaming of a summer festival illustrates the unease over the data center boom in the South.

wire.title: DOT cranks up its campaign to strip bike lane references from federal websites
wire.summary: Transportation officials have removed a growing list of safety materials that mention bike lanes from federal websites. Safety advocates warn that's undermining proven measures for reducing crashes.

wire.title: Oil prices hit $100 for the first time since May
wire.summary: The price of Brent crude rose more than 6% on Thursday as the war in the Middle East continues to escalate.

wire.title: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump
wire.summary: The US president says the landmark agreement to help Saudis develop nuclear energy is dependent on it joining the Abraham Accords.

wire.title: France evacuates 20,000 as wildfires spread in south-west
wire.summary: Most of those evacuated were tourists from campsites around Arcachon Bay in France's Gironde region.

wire.title: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudi tanker as US launches more Iran strikes
wire.summary: The Iran-backed group, which previously announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia, also claims to have hit another vessel.

wire.title: 'I am still alive': Indian activist on hunger strike for 26 days loses 11kg
wire.summary: Sonam Wangchuk has been the main draw at the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest in Delhi.

wire.title: Teen jailed for exam cheating in Guinea dies after sickle cell complications, father says
wire.summary: Mamadou Djouma Bah, 17, was arrested and sentenced to prison for exam fraud earlier this month.
